name: raiar-mensagens
description: Sistema SaaS de cópia de mensagens categorizadas

scripts.start: cd backend && npm run dev & cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: echo 'Use `npm run build:backend` and `npm run build:frontend` separately'
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
